question: In a single conversation, a user has asked Claude to create three separate artifacts: a Python script, an HTML landing page, and a Markdown report. The user now asks Claude to update "the landing page" to change its header color. What should Claude do?
options: A) Create a fourth, brand-new artifact containing just the updated header, since existing artifacts cannot be selected for further edits
B) Ask the user to delete the other two artifacts first, since only one artifact can exist in a conversation at any given time
C) Identify the HTML landing page artifact among the three open artifacts and apply the header color change to that specific one
D) Update all three artifacts with the header color change, since a single conversation can only track edits collectively across every open artifact
correct_answers: C) Identify the HTML landing page artifact among the three open artifacts and apply the header color change to that specific one
explanations: Incorrect. Existing artifacts can be selected and updated directly; a disconnected new artifact would not represent an edit to the original landing page.
Incorrect. Multiple artifacts can coexist in the same conversation; deleting the others is not required to edit one of them.
Correct. Claude.ai supports multiple artifacts within one conversation, and Claude can identify which specific artifact the user is referring to and update that one.
Incorrect. Edits target the specific artifact identified by the user's request, not every artifact in the conversation.
